metrics.labelled: post hoc; development read; no training; the 20 states shaped the locator; changes no earlier verdict; the test approved by the user, details not reviewed
metrics.mapping: per VLA and layout, N2 N3 N5 pooled over locator seeds: RAISES iff s(LS)-s(intact) has CI lower bound above 0 and exceeds 0.10; PERCEPTION HOLDS iff RAISES and s(H1)-s(LS) <= 0.10; PERCEPTION COSTS iff RAISES and s(H1)-s(LS) > 0.10; NO FIX iff not RAISES. KNOWN COST qualifies the verdict iff K4 and K6 lose more than 0.05 against H1
metrics.oracle_kept: object height and rest height, yaw and size, target positions, role assignment, camera matrices
metrics.prediction: PERCEPTION HOLDS on all four; the bottle in the new layout does worst
metrics.written_before: any rollout outside the smoke, which uses smoke states 0-3
